blocks.text: Har cloud deployment model ke apne faide aur nuqsan hain; kaunsa behtar hai, yeh organization ki khaas zarooraton aur goals (maqsad) par depend karta hai.

items: Comparison (saath rakh kar farq dekhna): public clouds saste hain lekin kam mehfooz. Private clouds zyada mehfooz hain lekin mehngi. Hybrid clouds flexibility (zaroorat ke mutabiq badal sakna) deti hain, jabke multi-clouds resilience (mushkil mein bhi chalte rehne ki taqat) deti hain.

blocks.caption: Deployment models ka comparison (kitab ki line table ki shakal mein)
rows: flexible (zaroorat ke mutabiq badal sakne wala)
resilience: ek provider ruke to doosre chalte rehte hain

blocks.prompt: Kam paise aur baghair sensitive (naazuk, jise chhupa kar rakhna zaroori ho) data wala ek chhota start-up kaunsa model chune?
blocks.explanation: Public cloud, kyunke yeh sab se sasta hai aur foran shuru ho sakta hai; sensitive data na hone ki wajah se zyada security ki zaroorat nahi.

items: Public sasta magar kam mehfooz; private mehfooz magar mehnga.
